facts.quote: We are Outdoor Voices We make Technical Apparel for Recreation At Outdoor Voices, we make Technical Apparel for Recreation, designing the uniform for Doing Things with materials made for movement.
Outdoor Voices collaborates with a wide range of influencers, from fitness enthusiasts to lifestyle bloggers, to promote its products.
Challenge Outdoor Voices, a disruptive activewear brand, hired Blinker to improve re-engagement with lapsed customers through their email marketing.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Outdoor Voices team,

We are a small Instagram content studio and would like to propose a collaborative post with you. We are Outdoor Voices, a brand that designs technical apparel for recreation, specifically creating the uniform for doing things with materials made for movement. You collaborate with a wide range of influencers, from fitness enthusiasts to lifestyle bloggers, to promote your products. Outdoor Voices challenges disruptive activewear brands like Challenge Outdoor Voices, hiring Blinker to improve re-engagement with lapsed customers through their email marketing.

The proposed post would be a collaborative Instagram post, created together with your team. It would showcase a visually appealing image or short video featuring a key element of Outdoor Voices’s design philosophy – perhaps a moment of movement or a detail of the apparel. We envision working together to build a shared visual experience that resonates with your audience.

Please reply if you’d like to discuss this further.

The BrandPilot team
